Nothing on the station side is lost in these two files. Both files compile. The three names they import from vdj_database_safety.py.merged exist with matching signatures: is_virtualdj_running() at :80, assert_crlf_bytes(raw, what) at :502 and assert_vdj_song_form(raw, what) at :665. It is the House sidecar: saved_at 2026-10-08T23:02:28.791642, 73416 rows, 708 tracks. The base/station joblib (8731d3fc…) matches the base JSON instead (2026-08-30, 67763 rows, 669 tracks). Both joblibs carry the same 95 feature names as station's MODEL_FEATURE_NAMES (worked out statically from vdj_cuer/ml/features.py), so either one would load. cue_bar_clf.joblib.merged is a 0-byte placeholder and must not ship.

Your goal was for the fixes to last in the AutoCue logic itself, not just in House. That depends almost entirely on vdj_database_safety.py.merged, not on file_processor.py. process_audio_file has no caller in either repo. The real AutoCue write path is cue_writer._apply_cues_to_database (station cue_writer.py:1217) → rewrite_song_xml_in_database → _replace_database_parts_locked. The merged module does put House's CRLF and Song-form gates on that path. But it creates a semantic conflict between the two sides. House's heal_song_form (merged :1532) rewrites the candidate before writing. It moves Comment to right after Infos and indents a column-0 </Song> by one space. Station's new read-back check (merged :1454-1460) then compares the un-healed song_xml against the file on disk. I ran it in memory with the merged module's own format_vdj_poi_line and inject_pois_into_song_xml on a correctly formed CRLF song. With or without a comment, heal changes the bytes, the gates pass, the database is replaced, and then the check raises "Write read-back mismatch … treat as NOT saved". So every AutoCue write would land but be reported as failed: _apply_cues_to_database returns False and autocue_job returns ok=False. Calling canonical_song_block(song_xml) before the splice fixes it. I tested that: heal_song_form then makes no change and the read-back passes, with and without a comment.

issues.detail: Semantic merge conflict on the live AutoCue write path. inject_pois_into_song_xml (:1001 rstrip leaves </Song> at column 0; :1007-1008 appends Comment after the Poi lines) produces a Song block that House's heal_song_form (called in _replace_database_parts_locked at :1532) always rewrites. Station's new read-back check in rewrite_song_xml_in_database (:1454-1460) compares the pre-heal song_xml with the healed file, so it always raises RuntimeError AFTER os.replace and _post_write_gate have already committed the write. I reproduced this in memory with the merged module: heal changed the bytes, the post-heal form had no problems, and `_n2(song_xml) in _n2(back)` was False, both with and without a comment. Result: the cues are written, but station cue_writer.py:1250 returns False, _invalidate_metadata_cache is skipped, and autocue_job.py:279 reports 'AutoCue failed while writing cues.' Station UI callers of rewrite_song_xml_in_database hit the same false failure. Not caught by tests: with MUSIC_SORTER_ALLOW_LF_DB=1, heal_song_form is a no-op (:678), so that env var hides this conflict.
issues.fix: In rewrite_song_xml_in_database, right after the CRLF normalization (around :1428-1430), add `song_xml = canonical_song_block(song_xml)` (when newline == '\r\n'). I verified that heal_song_form is then a no-op and the read-back check passes. For blocks canonical_song_block leaves alone (multi-line children), make the read-back compare the Song span found in `back` via _find_song_span, not a substring of the pre-heal text. Note _post_write_gate (:1599) already checks byte-for-byte that back == candidate_raw.

summary:
The text merge is correct, but one semantic conflict has to be fixed before this can become canonical.

(1) House changes: all present. `.merged` is byte-identical to `git merge-file -p station base house`, with no conflicts. A per-definition 3-way comparison shows all 41 House-only definitions identical to `.house`: the readonly guards, `LineEndingError`, the CRLF gate, Song-form checks and healing, `to_crlf`, `autocue_safety_module`, the post-write gate with rollback, the ps-based `is_virtualdj_running`, Pos dropped at 0, CRLF serialization, CRLF-checked recovery and the CRLF-checked `copy_database_atomically`. `import sys` is present too.

(2) Station changes: present. The only station-side change since base is `rewrite_song_xml_in_database` (the `base_song_xml` stale check and the post-write read-back). It is identical to `.station`.

(3) Structure: `ast.parse` passes, there are no duplicate top-level definitions, no conflict markers and no undefined globals (symtable check).

(4) API compatibility: every symbol imported from `vdj_database_safety` exists in `.merged`. This covers both repos' `ui/app.py`, `ui/sorter/*.py` and `vdj_cuer/**/*.py`, including `import vdj_database_safety as V/_safety` attribute uses: 44 names, among them `_replace_database_parts_locked`, `canonical_song_block`, `legacy_fixture_mode`, `assert_crlf_bytes`, `assert_vdj_song_form` and `__file__`. All call sites are compatible with the merged signatures, including keyword args (`base_song_xml` at station `cue_writer.py:1217`, `**attrs` into `format_vdj_poi_line` at `cue_writer.py:1054`). Zero mismatches.

Blocker: station's read-back check in `rewrite_song_xml_in_database` compares the caller's raw `song_xml` against the file. House's `_replace_database_parts_locked` now heals the whole file before writing, so `inject_pois_into_song_xml` and station `notes_edit` output no longer matches what lands on disk. Every AutoCue apply and most 8787 edits then raise "Write read-back mismatch … treat as NOT saved" even though the file was written. I reproduced this on a temp CRLF database and verified a one-line fix.

Tests: station tests need the House `MUSIC_SORTER_ALLOW_LF_DB` conftest, otherwise 14 new failures in `tests/` and 39 in `ui/tests`. With that flag and the fix, results match the station baseline: 134/135 in `tests/` and 153/153 in the `ui/tests` write tests. The one remaining failure is the existing `ModuleNotFoundError` for `sorter`. House gate tests behave the same with `.merged` as with `.house`.

House-specific behavior in this module that would apply to 8787:
- `MUSIC_SORTER_READONLY` guards. Inert on station, which never sets the variable.
- `MUSIC_SORTER_ALLOW_LF_DB` test-fixture bypass.
- A hardcoded `/Users/kirilllanger/src/vdj-automatic-cuer` second-opinion path. It is a symlink to vdj-station, so it loads the station working tree.
- Much slower writes, because of the Song-form scan and the full re-parse after each write.
- Pos omitted at 0:00, which the station `cue_edit` move path does not handle.

There is no `profile=house` or notes-dir logic in this module.

issues.detail: Semantic conflict between station's read-back in rewrite_song_xml_in_database (merged:1454-1460, `if _n2(song_xml) not in _n2(back): raise RuntimeError('Write read-back mismatch ... treat as NOT saved.')`) and House's whole-file `heal_song_form` in `_replace_database_parts_locked` (merged:1532). heal rewrites `\r\n</Song>` to `\r\n </Song>` and moves a late <Comment> to just after <Infos>. Two producers always emit exactly those seams: `inject_pois_into_song_xml` (merged:1000-1011, where `rstrip(' \t')` drops the space before </Song> and Comment is appended after the Pois) and station `ui/sorter/notes_edit.py:35-59 apply_comment_to_song_xml`. Reproduced on a VDJ-form CRLF temp DB. With `.station` and `.house` the write is OK. With `.merged` it raises RuntimeError for inject without a comment, inject with a comment, and the notes_edit comment, yet the file WAS changed (cue/comment present). There is no rollback because the check sits outside the rollback block. Impact: station `vdj_cuer/cue_writer.py:1217` returns False ('Error applying cues') for every AutoCue track and skips `_invalidate_metadata_cache`. Every 8787 UI edit through `rewrite_song_xml_in_database` (cue_edit, notes_edit, bpm_edit, grid_edit, poi_rename, relocate) reports failure after a successful write, and a retry then trips the base_song_xml stale check. Existing tests do not catch it because `MUSIC_SORTER_ALLOW_LF_DB=1` disables heal.
issues.fix: In `rewrite_song_xml_in_database`, inside `if newline == "\r\n":` right after merged:1431, add: `if not legacy_fixture_mode(): song_xml = heal_song_form(song_xml.encode("utf-8")).decode("utf-8")`. The block that is size-guarded and read back is then exactly what the whole-file heal writes; heal is idempotent on that region. Verified with a scratch copy: the probes pass, the 135 station tests give 134 pass + 1 existing failure, the 153 station ui write tests pass, and the House gate tests give 33 pass + 6 skipped.

issues.detail: Write latency and lock hold time grow a lot for 8787 and AutoCue. Single rewrite_song_xml_in_database on a synthetic 21 MB VDJ-form CRLF DB (17k songs x 8 cues): `.station` 0.45 s, merged + fix 12.7 s. cProfile breakdown (inflated by profiling): song_form_problems 11.7 s (153k `_attr_order_ok` calls), `_post_write_gate` 7.7 s (iterparse plus `_raw_integrity_stats`), heal 0.66 s. House's own comment (merged:1609-1611) says about 3 s on the real 38 MB DB. The exclusive flock is held for the whole time, so 8787 click edits and concurrent AutoCue children serialize on multi-second writes. House already accepts this.

Also, the read-back (merged:1454-1460) runs after os.replace and outside the rollback, so even a genuine mismatch leaves new bytes on disk while the message says 'NOT saved'.
